questions.q: Explain why the Farewell Pilgrimage was important for Muslims.
questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ showed the rites of Hajj in full, gave his final sermon and 5:3 announced the religion was complete.

questions.q: On which day do pilgrims stand at Arafah?
Hajj map task on the pupil PDF: label Mina, Arafah and Muzdalifah, add the days and what happened, then in the portal response box: 'The Farewell Pilgrimage matters because ...' (one PEEL paragraph).
questions.a: Correct map and days; paragraph with 5:3 and 'take your rites from me'
The Prophet ﷺ hinted he might not meet them again and died about three months later.

questions.q: Stretch: what does 'perfected your religion' (5:3) mean for adding new acts of worship?
questions.a: Islam is complete: nothing new is added to worship.
A) At Arafah. On the day of Arafah in the Farewell Pilgrimage (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: 'Take your rites from me' refers to ...
Think again: what did the Prophet ﷺ make sure to tell them?
questions.a: The rites, and the core messages of his sermon.
